title: Beach Please Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Please is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to Beach Please at 202 East Royal Fern Way, a stunning 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath coastal retreat located in WaterColor’s Crossing District. Designed for style and comfort, this home offers luxurious interiors, a private pool and hot tub, and premium outdoor living spaces perfect for family gatherings or group getaways along scenic 30A.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with up to 13 Passes Included 6-Passenger Street Legal Golf Cart 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Two Master Suites Private Pool with Hot Tub (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Outdoor Lounge Area with Fireplace and TV Natural Gas Grill Sonic Ice Machine Parking for 2 Vehicles 4-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside 5-Minute Golf Cart Ride to WaterColor’s Beach Club Access Experience the Home Experience elevated coastal living at 202 East Royal Fern Way, where sophisticated design meets modern comfort. Located in the desirable Crossing District, this home blends timeless beachside charm with thoughtful luxury. Step inside to find a bright, open concept living space with stunning shiplap walls, hardwood floors, and designer furnishings. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with quartzite countertops, Thermador appliances, a beverage refrigerator, and a large island with seating for four. Gather around the elegant dining table for eight or relax in the light-filled living room after a day of exploring WaterColor. The first-floor master suite offers a tranquil retreat featuring a king bed and a luxurious private bathroom complete with a soaking tub, walk-in glass shower, and dual vanities. This level also includes a stylish mudroom and office nook, a half bathroom, and a convenient laundry room. Upstairs, four additional bedrooms provide elegant accommodations for guests. Two king suites include private bathrooms, while a third bedroom offers a queen bed and twin bed combination with its own en- suite. The built-in bunk room features four twin beds, creating a playful and cozy space for children. Outside, enjoy your private oasis with a sparkling pool, spa, and turf area designed for relaxation and fun. The outdoor lounge features a fireplace, flat-screen TV, and plush seating, ideal for evening gatherings or game nights under the stars. The natural gas grill makes outdoor dining a breeze. With a 6-passenger golf cart and six adult bikes included, exploring the WaterColor community and nearby Seaside is effortless. Beach Please combines resort-style amenities, sophisticated design, and unbeatable location for the ultimate 30A experience.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Half Bathroom Laundry Room Second Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2) and Twin Bed (1), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Combination Bunk Room: Twin over Twin over Twin Bunk Bed with Trundle (4) Life in WaterColor Surrounded by scenic trails, parks, and sparkling pools, Beach Please at 202 East Royal Fern Way is perfectly positioned for exploring all that WaterColor has to offer. Cruise to the Beach Club, enjoy afternoons at Camp WaterColor, or visit the boutiques and restaurants of nearby Seaside. Every detail of this home ensures a relaxing, unforgettable stay.
